answer: The protocol builds a trellis of peer‑prediction contracts where each AI submits a report on a timber‑related fable task and stakes a fixed deposit. After a round, the Bayesian truth serum scores each report by its informativeness relative to the aggregate; only the top‑scoring agents receive the reward, while the rest lose their stake. An attacker must lock up the deposit (e.g., 10 tokens) for every fake identity and forfeit it if the report falls outside the top‑10 %, making a Sybil cost of 10 tokens per identity per round.
